question: Does the Phase 45 leave-one-brand-out result survive when both folder classes share one size, encoder, and metadata state?
claim_scope: real photograph versus AI-generated image. Not authentic versus counterfeit watch.

steps: alpha composited on white; other modes converted to RGB
center crop to the short side
baseline JPEG quality 90, 4:2:0, no EXIF, no ICC
normalization.exclusion: short side below 448 after EXIF transpose; never upscaled

unchanged_from_phase45: role assignment per fold and for the random-split control
DINOv3 cls_patch_attention, 512 input, hyperparameters, checkpoint selection, calibration, threshold 0.50
residual_risks: Every Label_1 file is scaled by the same factor (512 to 448); Label_0 factors vary.
Prompt style and scene content can still differ between folders.
Folder labels are not verified ground truth.
